notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
- Added the ability to select the difficulty level in the settings menu.
- Fixed a bug when the character goes to the right at the start of the level.

notes.title: Sprint mode changes
notes.content: Now in the settings you can switch the sprint mode. You can choose the mode that is most comfortable for you. Running while holding the sprint button or a single press that switches the mode. This feature is under testing, so if you find any bugs, please let us know.

notes.title: Balance changes V2
notes.content:
- Added a training level where you can practice overcoming traps. The training area contains only those traps that require practice to complete the main campaign.

- Now, at the start, the character has 3 revivals.

- Reduced trap damage.

- More respawn capsules have been added on some levels.

notes.title: Balance changes. April 13.
notes.content: Added more health and revival capsules at all levels.
